突然间一阵的地动山摇，林沧海眼见着，就要从山上轱辘下去，突然间眼角一斜，不远处竟然有一颗树。

“你说的没错，他们确实是邪教。”
李木子用赞赏的眼神看着林沧海，收到目光的林沧海一愣，这也行，胡诌都诌对了。
一帮人在台上争得是面红耳赤，谁也不服谁，直到一名身着紫袍，肤色黝黑，面色深沉的胖子在几名内卫府银甲校尉的簇拥下出现之后，他们才是噤声不语。
青衣武者本就距离北辰十分的近，而且是全力追着北辰的，并没有想到北辰会突然停下，也没有想到北辰会转过身来偷袭他，而且现在他能清楚地感受到北辰身上的气势，几乎已经恢复到了巅峰状态。
“第二个条件，既然你们选我做队长，那么我的指令，各位就必须遵守，否则的话，这队长我不干。”
林沧海和兄弟们有些郁闷的出警察局，不禁纳闷了这算是怎么回事？做了好事居然进了警察局，被问长问短的，想起来之前警察们那严谨的架势，林沧海不禁摇头叹气。

> Chapter 219 Sir (Page 1)
Sir (Mr. (Page 22)) She wanted to accuse him of being rude, but she saw him staring at her with a gloomy and complicated face, such a strange and vaguely angry look... as if she had done something to him that she shouldn't have done.
Suddenly, there was an earthquake and the mountains shook. Lin Canghai saw it and was about to go down the mountain. Suddenly, out of the corner of his eye, he saw a tree not far away.
Sure enough, as soon as he opened the door, one of his cronies appeared at the door. He glanced at everyone in a panic, and finally stayed on Du Wan for a moment, hesitated, walked quietly to Du Wan, and whispered a few words in Wang Zhi's ear.
Entering the competition arena again, Ying Changkong, Qin Hong and others have arrived, and there are also many strong people from the Tianbang who have arrived here. A dignified and depressing atmosphere is generated between the two sides.
"You're right, they are indeed a cult."
Li Muzi looked at Lin Canghai with admiring eyes. Lin Canghai was stunned when he received the look. That's okay, all the nonsense was correct.
A group of people were arguing on the stage with red faces and no one was convinced. It was not until a fat man with a dark complexion and a deep complexion in a purple robe appeared surrounded by several silver-armored captains of the Imperial Guard that they remained silent.
The warrior in green clothes was already very close to Beichen, and he was chasing Beichen with all his strength. He did not expect that Beichen would stop suddenly, nor did he expect that Beichen would turn around and attack him. Moreover, now he could clearly feel Beichen's aura, which had almost returned to its peak state.
"The second condition is that since you have chosen me to be the captain, you must abide by my instructions. Otherwise, I will not be the captain."
Lin Canghai and his brothers left the police station a little depressed, and couldn't help but wonder what was going on? After doing a good deed, he actually entered the police station and was questioned. Thinking of the strict posture of the police before, Lin Canghai couldn't help but shake his head and sigh.
